title: Pre-trade checklist
dek: Inner reasoning wing: the five fields every trade fills before it goes on, with a worked example from the proposed book of Oct 26, 2026.

claims.text: Worked example N3 (the fade), proposed book of 2026-10-26: the 1R play cap ($250,000) over a worst case of $2,680 per lot set 93 lots of short C135 / long C138, collecting $29,760. Episode shock at size $62,939. The most it can lose is the full $249,240 worst case.
